acceptance_tests: G1: implements R01-R16 of artifacts/formulation/rule_spec.json by rule id, parameterised by --class/--expect-class
G2: 2 conforming fixtures (one WCC, one SCC) accepted; >=12 mutant fixtures each rejected with the expected rule id; no mutant silently passes
G3: runs unchanged on the three canonical schemas once published; emits JSON {class_id, sha256, per_rule:{rule_id:status,json_path}, verdict}
G4: exit 0 iff all rules pass; exit 3 if canonical file absent (not a pass)
G5: does NOT import or shell out to any other worker's gate (primary implementation; independence is the point)
do_not_claim: No node completion, no theorem, no physics result. Report unverified; the schema owner (lead-formulation) binds interpretation. Write only under your own artifacts/<worker>/ path.
falsifier: Gate accepts any mutant fixture, or rejects a canonical schema for a rule which a domain reviewer shows is a legitimate formulation -> gate invalid, rejected at review.
revision_requirements: R04 one-end topology and R08 'conclusion is the negation of visibility' are WCC-specific; make every rule class-parameterised (SCC conclusion is future-inextendibility, never visibility).
ALLOWED_CONCLUSION_TYPES must be {open_problem, formal_model, conditional_theorem}; theorem is rejected without artifact_refs.
Add R13 composite-regularity ban and R16 implication-ledger rule from the published rule spec.
stop_rule: 4.0 agent-hours or when the canonical schema hash appears and one gate run is recorded, whichever is first.
title: Canonical executable class-schema gate, parameterised per class (your WP13-F1-GATE, accepted with revisions).
